items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Mr. Menton, who later opened the famous Menton's Inn, was the Harlem delegate

ctx.x: Another theater on 125th Street called the Apollo started having stage shows and it was Benny Carter's band that inaugurated the grand opening and also played the first two weeks there. But there existed a system that was called kick-back to the 802 Union delegate.
Mr. Menton, who later opened the famous Menton's Inn, was the Harlem delegate and if the kick-back system benefited anyone, it must have been him.
It was the days of gangsterism and a leader and his men had to go along with the system if they wanted to work.
